description: Global Hydropower Database (GHD) and hydroelectricity production (HP) model is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Wenhua Wan. 1. GHD comprises 8716 hydropower plants distributed across 134 countries. The detailed description can be found in the Supplementary and the main text of the following article:Wan W, Zhao J, Popat E, Herbert C, Döll P. Analyzing the Impact of Streamflow Drought on Hydroelectricity Production: A Global-Scale Study. Water Resources Research. 2021, 4(57):e2020WR028087. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1054080492 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
